source_note: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia ՀՕ-124-Ն (arlis.am redaction 23.12.2022-06.04.2023; owner confirmed current 22 Nov 2026). Quotes and article reading in docs/legal/PRE_REVIEW.md. Lawyer must confirm.
basis: Art. 95(1): fixed-term only where the work or its conditions do not allow an indefinite term; Art. 95(3) lists categories; Art. 94: otherwise indefinite. The Code does not require the ground to be written in the contract (Art. 84(1)(9) asks only for the term), so this is a data-quality check.

title.hy: Որոշակի ժամկետով պայմանագրի համար 95-րդ հոդվածով նախատեսված հիմք գրանցված չէ
title.ru: Для срочного договора не записано основание по ст. 95
title.en: Fixed-term contract has no recorded ground under Art. 95

edge_cases: Advisory data-quality check: no Art. 95 ground recorded. Not a statutory breach by itself; without a qualifying ground the contract is deemed indefinite (Art. 94).
Skipped when the ground is unknown (null); an empty string means explicitly none. A skipped rule never auto-resolves an open finding.
Checks presence of a ground, not whether it fits Art. 95(3). A ground list aligned to 95(3) is not built yet.
